body:
## Problem

`packages/frontend/data/gearPriceHistory.js`, `derek-roddy` entry (Hate Eternal "I, Monarch" 2005 era), `setup.heads` block (lines 6425-6439):
```
heads: {
  item: 'Remo Emperor / Powerstroke 3',
  model: 'Emperor toms, Powerstroke 3 kick',
  ...
  year: 2005,
  source: 'Remo retail pricing 2005',
  notes: "Switched to Powerstroke 3 for a focused, punchy kick attack.",
  ...
},
```
This entry self-contradicts its own `priceEvolution` array in the same file (line 6467): `{ year: 2018, ..., event: 'Continued Tama/Meinl setup, Evans EMAD2 kick heads' }` — the 2018 row already correctly says Evans, but the 2005 `setup.heads` block never made the switch, so the two blocks disagree on brand within the same entry. Note: this is unrelated to the held #7981 (snare model conflict in extendedBios.js/genreGearGuides.js) — different field, different files.

## Verified (internal source of truth)

`packages/frontend/data/endorsementNews.js`, `derek-roddy` `currentEndorsements`:
```
heads: { brand: 'Evans', model: 'Genera HD Dry / EMAD', since: '2001' },
```
No heads timeline entry exists (a known sibling-field-miss gap, out of scope here), but `currentEndorsements` itself is the sourced fact per this file's schema: Evans since 2001 — four years before this entry's 2005 setup date, i.e. Evans (not Remo) was already his heads brand by the "I, Monarch" era.

## Fix

In `packages/frontend/data/gearPriceHistory.js`, `derek-roddy` `setup.heads` block: change `item` from `'Remo Emperor / Powerstroke 3'` to `'Evans Genera HD Dry / EMAD'` (or era-appropriate Evans model), updating `source`/`notes` accordingly so the 2005 block agrees with both `endorsementNews.js` and this entry's own 2018 `priceEvolution` row.

## Verify
- [ ] `grep -n "Remo Emperor / Powerstroke 3" packages/frontend/data/gearPriceHistory.js` within the derek-roddy block returns zero hits
- [ ] `setup.heads` cites Evans, matching both `endorsementNews.js` and the entry's own 2018 `priceEvolution` row
- [ ] Drums/cymbals/hardware/sticks fields (already correct, Tama/Meinl/Tama/Vater) left untouched

## Done
`gearPriceHistory.js`'s `derek-roddy` `setup.heads` block matches `endorsementNews.js`'s verified Evans-since-2001 record and no longer contradicts the entry's own `priceEvolution` array; zero new pages/URLs.
title: SEO: Derek Roddy gearPriceHistory.js setup.heads says Remo at 2005 — verified Evans since 2001, and the entry's own 2018 priceEvolution row already says Evans
